notes.title: Bomb Squad V1.5 Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

I am really excited to announce the release of Bomb Squad Academy V1.5.

This update includes several UI and performance improvements, but more importantly, it contains almost [b]twice[/b] as many puzzles as the initial release.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27972766/ce935f291c09ba07e85b7da69235a9f9d1c3dea6.jpg[/img]

It also includes a few other changes, namely Steam Cloud support, trading cards and localization.

I really hope you enjoy this free update, and thanks again for playing!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27972766/45e47bcc7143898b66f6951ece2662fe1d3d434c.png[/img]
Jean
